tooltip.linear.exposure: Exposure in stops. +1 doubles linear RGB values.
tooltip.linear.source_x: CIE x coordinate of the specified source white point. Chromatic adaptation maps the source white point to the current working white point.
tooltip.linear.source_y: CIE y coordinate of the specified source white point. Chromatic adaptation maps the source white point to the current working white point.
tooltip.linear.cr_spread: Percentage change in the Cyan-Red reference displacement from the working white point in CIE xy. -100 collapses this direction to white. +100 doubles its displacement.
tooltip.linear.yb_spread: Percentage change in the Yellow-Blue reference displacement from the working white point in CIE xy. -100 collapses this direction to white. +100 doubles its displacement.
tooltip.linear.cr_balance: Exposure balance between the two sides of the Cyan-Red axis. Positive values darken the red direction and brighten the cyan direction. Negative values reverse the effect.
tooltip.linear.yb_balance: Exposure balance between the two sides of the Yellow-Blue axis. Positive values darken the blue direction and brighten the yellow direction. Negative values reverse the effect.
tooltip.tone.black: Inputs at this nit value map to black. Lower input values become pure black.
tooltip.tone.shadows: Inputs at this nit value map to the same perceptual lightness as the neutral Shadows anchor.
tooltip.tone.midtones: Inputs at this nit value map to the same perceptual lightness as 18% grey.
tooltip.tone.white: Inputs at this nit value map to the same perceptual lightness as the neutral White anchor.
tooltip.tone.highlights: Inputs at this nit value map to the same perceptual lightness as the neutral Peak Anchor.
tooltip.tone.fit: Higher values bring the curve closer to its control points and concentrate each control point’s influence.
tooltip.tone.reference: Luminance in nits of a neutral value of 1 in the working space. This calibrates the perceptual model and the tonal targets. The Peak Anchor is kept at least twice this value.
tooltip.family.j: Adjust perceptual lightness by adding contributions from chroma and opponent coordinates.
tooltip.family.c: Adjust logarithmic chroma gain using chroma and opponent coordinates.
tooltip.family.adaptance: Adjust near-neutral colors with chromatic-adaptation-inspired offsets along the opponent coordinates.
tooltip.family.hue: Adjust hue using tone, opponent coordinates and chroma.
tooltip.color.adaptance_strength: Strength of the adaptation-inspired offset. 0 applies zero offset. 1 applies the same offset at every chroma for a given perceptual lightness. Intermediate values protect high-chroma colors.
tooltip.stage.tone: Tonal remapping based on perceptual lightness
tooltip.action.add: Add linear color correction, a custom tone curve and color adjustments in modCAM16-UCS.
tooltip.action.match_white: Align the source white point with the current working white point to make chromatic adaptation an identity transform.
tooltip.action.reset_directions: Reset the six directional controls. Keep Global Exposure and the source white point.
tooltip.action.reset_tone: Reset the tone curve to an identity mapping.
tooltip.action.reset_color: Reset the current color page, including its global controls and curve fit.
tooltip.action.reset_stage: Reset every control in the selected stage. Shared Global Exposure belongs to the Linear stage.
tooltip.socket.reference: Show an external reference on vectorscopes, waveforms and the tone-curve histogram.
tooltip.linear.cr_heading: Counterclockwise angle of the Cyan-Red axis in the CIE xy plane.
tooltip.linear.yb_heading: Counterclockwise angle of the Yellow-Blue axis in the CIE xy plane.
tooltip.action.set_peak: Set the Highlights target to {value:,} neutral nits.
tooltip.color.j_fit: Fit of the tonal lightness adjustment curve. Higher values bring the curve closer to its control points and concentrate each control point’s influence.
tooltip.color.c_fit: Fit of the tonal chroma adjustment curve. Higher values bring the curve closer to its control points and concentrate each control point’s influence.
tooltip.color.adaptance_fit: Fit of the tonal Adaptance adjustment curve. Higher values bring the curve closer to its control points and concentrate each control point’s influence.
tooltip.color.hue_fit: Fit of the tonal hue adjustment curve. Higher values bring the curve closer to its control points and concentrate each control point’s influence.
tooltip.color.global_gain: Global chroma gain in stops. +1 doubles C. -1 halves C.
tooltip.color.global_low_hue: Rotate the hue of lower-chroma colors, with smooth chroma weighting. Positive values rotate hue counterclockwise in the a/b plane. Negative values rotate clockwise.
tooltip.color.global_high_hue: Rotate the hue of higher-chroma colors, with smooth chroma weighting. Positive values rotate hue counterclockwise in the a/b plane. Negative values rotate clockwise.
tooltip.dctl.source_x: CIE x coordinate of the specified source white point. Chromatic adaptation maps the source white point to the selected destination white point. Active when Source White is Custom xy.
tooltip.dctl.source_y: CIE y coordinate of the specified source white point. Chromatic adaptation maps the source white point to the selected destination white point. Active when Source White is Custom xy.
tooltip.dctl.cr_spread: Percentage change in the Cyan-Red reference displacement from the destination white point in CIE xy. -100 collapses this direction to white. +100 doubles its displacement.
tooltip.dctl.yb_spread: Percentage change in the Yellow-Blue reference displacement from the destination white point in CIE xy. -100 collapses this direction to white. +100 doubles its displacement.
tooltip.dctl.cr_heading: Counterclockwise angle of the Cyan-Red axis in the CIE xy plane.
tooltip.dctl.yb_heading: Counterclockwise angle of the Yellow-Blue axis in the CIE xy plane.
tooltip.dctl.source: Select the source white point for CAT16 chromatic adaptation. Custom xy uses the Source White x and y controls.
tooltip.dctl.destination: Select the destination white point for CAT16 and the appearance model. D60 daylight and ACES have distinct white coordinates.
tooltip.dctl.reference: Luminance in nits for input Y = 1. This calibrates the appearance model and tonal targets. Adapting and background luminance are 10% of this value.
tooltip.dctl.peak: Neutral luminance target for Highlights. The effective peak is at least twice the reference luminance.
tooltip.dctl.overlay: Show the CIE xy diagram with the reference and transformed boundaries, white-point markers and tonal landmarks.
tooltip.dctl.triangle: Select the reference triangle displayed on the diagram.
diagram.xy.title: CIE 1931 xy
action.reset_linear.label: Reset Linear Corrections
tooltip.action.reset_linear: Reset the linear corrections and align the source white point with the current working white point.

tooltip.render.method: Choose the pixel evaluation method for previews and rendering. Both methods use the same modCAM16-UCS grading model.
tooltip.render.lut: Uses a baked 65³ LUT with tetrahedral interpolation to compute the grade in working RGB. Recommended for shader nodes.
tooltip.render.direct: Computes the grade in modCAM16-UCS. Recommended for compositor nodes.

tooltip.gizmo.move_panel: Drag this header to move the grading panel.
tooltip.gizmo.scope_white: Drag to adjust the source white point using the vectorscope.
tooltip.gizmo.reference_toggle: Click to show or hide Color Reference in the scopes and tone-curve histogram.
tooltip.gizmo.selected_dot: Drag to adjust the selected tone. Click a dot to select its tone. The cross shows the mean of near-neutral pixels around this tone. The ellipse shows their 95% confidence region.
tooltip.gizmo.chroma_indicator: Click to select {tone}. Click the selected vertical indicator again to switch between Cₗ and Cₕ.
tooltip.gizmo.driver_selector: Select the lower-chroma or higher-chroma curve to edit. The selected curve and its histogram are emphasized.
tooltip.gizmo.select_tone: Select {tone}. Scopes and histograms use pixels around this input-tone region.
tooltip.gizmo.vectorscope: Shows the graded colors in Rec.709 vectorscope coordinates.
tooltip.gizmo.color_waveform: Shows perceptual lightness after the color adjustments, using pixels around the selected input tone.
tooltip.gizmo.neutral_statistics: Shows the mean and 95% confidence region of near-neutral pixels around the selected tone. Their displayed offsets and size are magnified five times.
tooltip.gizmo.peak_anchor: Set the Highlights target to 500, 1000, 2000 or 4000 nits.
tooltip.gizmo.input_level: Drag vertically to set the input level for this tone, expressed in neutral nits.
tooltip.gizmo.target_level: Select {tone}. This mark shows its neutral output target. Drag the corresponding input mark or curve dot to adjust the mapping.
tooltip.gizmo.input_curve: Drag horizontally to set the input nits for this tone.
tooltip.gizmo.before_waveform: Shows perceptual lightness after linear correction. Drag a level mark vertically to set the corresponding input tone.
tooltip.gizmo.after_waveform: Shows perceptual lightness after tone remapping. Click a level mark to select its tone.
tooltip.gizmo.tone_curve: Shows input and output perceptual lightness for the current mapping. Drag a control point horizontally to set its input level.
tooltip.gizmo.balance: Drag horizontally for Cyan-Red Balance and vertically for Yellow-Blue Balance.
tooltip.gizmo.white_xy: Drag to set the source white point in CIE xy.
tooltip.gizmo.direction: Drag an endpoint to adjust Spread and Heading around the working white point. The opposite endpoint mirrors its movement.
tooltip.gizmo.working_white: Shows the current working white point. Chromatic adaptation maps the source white point to this target.
tooltip.gizmo.edit_selected_dot: Drag here to adjust the selected tone. Click a dot to select its tone.

scope.stack.unavailable: Choose an enabled, editable Grade entry
tooltip.stack.enabled: Include this entry in the Stack. Bypassing preserves its Grade, direction and position.
tooltip.stack.add: Add an enabled, forward entry to this Stack.

tooltip.stack.up: Move this entry earlier in the Stack.
tooltip.stack.down: Move this entry later in the Stack.
tooltip.stack.invert: Toggle the inverse transform. Highlighted means Inverse.

tooltip.scope.stack.input: The image entering the complete Stack, measured in the selected Grade’s perceptual coordinates. Edit tone handles on the Grade curve.
tooltip.scope.stack.output: The complete Stack output from the currently installed LUT. Updates after baking finishes. Measurements and driver histograms use the selected Grade’s perceptual coordinates.
